items.example: Suddenly the lights went out.
items.simple: Something happens very fast and you did not expect it.

items.example: Guess what? I won a prize!
items.exampleTr: Tahmin et ne oldu? Bir ödül kazandım!
items.simple: You say this when you have big news to tell.
items.note: Haber vermeden önce merak uyandırmak için.

items.example: And then he just walked away.
items.simple: You say this to tell what came next in your story.

items.example: I was eating when the phone rang.
items.simple: Tell what you were doing, and what happened in the middle.

items.example: Luckily, I had an umbrella.
items.simple: Something good happened by chance, and it helped you.

items.example: You won't believe this, but I met a famous singer.
items.exampleTr: Buna inanmayacaksın ama ünlü bir şarkıcıyla tanıştım.
items.simple: You say this when your news is very strange or big.

items.example: It turned out he was my neighbour.
items.simple: At the end, you learn what was really true.

items.example: So I was walking home, right?
items.exampleTr: Ben de eve yürüyordum, değil mi?
items.simple: This is how you start telling a story about yourself.

items.example: Apparently, the shop closed down.
items.simple: This is what people say, or what it looks like.

items.example: Long story short, we missed the bus.
items.simple: You say this to tell the end fast, with no small bits.

items.example: Eventually, the bus came.
items.simple: After a long wait, the thing finally happens.

items.example: I nearly fell off my bike.
items.simple: Almost, but it did not happen.

items.example: The next thing I knew, I was on the floor.
items.simple: Everything went so fast that you did not see how.

items.example: It was a really weird day.
items.simple: Not normal. A bit strange.

items.example: Grandpa loves to tell a story.
items.simple: You say a story with your mouth so others can hear it.

items.example: Your story was hilarious!
items.simple: So funny that you laugh a lot.

items.example: Anyway, back to my story.
items.simple: You say this to go back to the main thing.

items.example: While I was cooking, the dog stole a sausage.
items.exampleTr: Ben yemek yaparken köpek bir sosis çaldı.
items.simple: Two things happen at the same time in the past.

items.example: We all burst out laughing.
items.simple: You start to laugh very loud, very fast.

items.example: Unfortunately, it started to rain.
items.simple: Something sad or bad happened. It was not lucky.

items.example: I was about to leave when she called.
items.exampleTr: Tam çıkmak üzereydim ki o aradı.
items.simple: You were ready to do it, but something stopped you.

items.example: It was an amazing night.
items.simple: So good that you cannot believe it.

items.example: The funny thing is, I knew him.
items.exampleTr: Komik olan şu ki, onu tanıyordum.
items.simple: You say this before the odd or funny part.
